records.title: HyperFlow H3 Flash (Video Rebirth)
records.summary: Video Rebirth's pruned, INT8 and few-step version of MiniMax-H3: 13.7B parameters instead of about 31B, 4-8 sampling steps without CFG, video with stereo audio in one pass. Ships as a Python package and as GGUF for ComfyUI.
records.why_it_matters: It brings MiniMax-H3 class output to a single consumer NVIDIA card with published end-to-end timings. It keeps the MiniMax-H3 territory exclusions, and the README gives no Apple Silicon path.
records.fit_notes: On the M3 Max: no documented path. The Python package needs an NVIDIA GPU and CUDA, and the GGUF route is described for ComfyUI on RTX cards; a stable-diffusion.cpp patch exists, but nothing says it was run on Metal. Rent an RTX 4090 or 5090 instead: 5.2 s takes about 1.5-2.5 min there. First run downloads about 90 GB (68 GB with the fp8 text encoder). Weights inherit the MiniMax-H3 licence, so the same EU, UK, Korea and US exclusion applies as on model:minimaxai/minimax-h3. The vendor published the timings; a commenter asks for a quality comparison against the quants and against FastVideo's FastH3, which was not opened here.

related.note: A compressed derivative of the MiniMax-H3 transformer under the same community licence.

claims.text: On the vendor's runs, a 5.2 s clip at 6 steps took 8.7 s on 4x B200, 36 s on one H200 and 92 s on one RTX 5090.
claims.quote: **Speed (5.2 s clip, 6 steps):** 8.7 s on 4× B200, 36 s on 1× H200, 92 s on 1× RTX 5090.

claims.text: The Python package requires an Ampere or newer NVIDIA GPU with CUDA.
claims.quote: Python 3.10+, PyTorch 2.6+ with CUDA and Triton (`pip install triton-windows` on native Windows), an Ampere or newer NVIDIA GPU, and `diffusers >= 0.40`.

claims.text: The weights are a MiniMax-H3 derivative whose licence does not cover the EU, UK, South Korea or US without MiniMax's authorization.
claims.quote: The weights are a derivative of MiniMax-H3 under its Community License, which does not cover the US, EU, UK or South Korea without MiniMax’s authorization.
